entities.name: Alniul
entities.description: A human shaman from Tarkir and head whisperer and co-leader of the Temur Frontier.

entities.name: Temur Frontier
entities.description: Clan co-led by Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul.

entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: Revered warrior and co-leader of the Temur.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Assisted by Alniul in discovering the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual that led to the overthrow of the dragonlords.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: Survivor of the blight in a village on the Temur edge; later traveled with Eshki and Alniul.

entities.name: Atarka clan
entities.description: Clan whose desperate members' angry spirits caused the blight.

events.summary: Alniul foretells Eshki's victory against Atarka and assists Narset in discovering the Stormnexus Ritual.
events.quote: assisted Narset in discovering the Stormnexus Ritual

events.summary: Blight strikes Surrak's village; he survives thanks to his great strength.
events.quote: Thanks to his great strength, he managed to survive the disease.

events.summary: Eshki and Alniul find Surrak near death, and the three commune with the spirits to learn the blight was born from angry Atarka spirits.
events.quote: finding Surrak in a pool of blue on the verge of death

events.summary: They pledge all would be welcome at the Temur fires, ending the blight; Surrak rejoins the clan and travels with Eshki and Alniul.
events.quote: They pledged that all would be welcome at the fires of the Temur, and the blight was brought to an end.

relations.quote: the head whisperer of the Temur Frontier
Alniul is co-leader of the Temur Frontier with Eshki Dragonclaw
